name: EZ Bar Curl
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the EZ bar in front of your thighs with a comfortable underhand grip.
Pin your elbows to your sides, brace your core, and keep your chest upright.
Curl the bar smoothly up toward your shoulders by flexing at the elbows without shifting your upper arms forward.
Pause briefly to contract your biceps at the top, then lower the bar with control back to the start.
tips: Control the lowering phase instead of letting the bar drop quickly.
Keep your torso still and avoid using hip momentum to lift heavier loads.
